description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation," illustrates the proportion of data sources used in the simulation, with each segment labeled and connected by a line to its corresponding percentage. The chart is composed of five distinct slices: a large blue segment representing ENTITYQUEST at 26.0%, a red segment for HOTPOTQA at 24.2%, an orange segment for TRIVIAQA at 22.7%, a yellow segment for POPQA at 21.6%, and a small green segment for TREC at 1.9%. A light gray segment, labeled as 3.6%, is positioned at the top of the chart but lacks a corresponding label, suggesting it may represent a category not explicitly named in the legend. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest segments (ENTITYQUEST and HOTPOTQA) positioned at the top right and the smallest (TREC) at the bottom left. The percentages are displayed next to each labeled segment, providing a clear visual breakdown of the data source distribution.
